title: GOLD: Geometric Optimized Latent Diffusion for Structure-Aware RNA Inverse Folding
abstract: arXiv:2610.22992v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Designing RNA sequences that fold into specific 3D structures is a fundamental challenge in therapeutics. Current RNA inverse folding methods typically condition on 3D backbone coordinates but the generation is limited to 1D discrete sequences. This ignores the continuous side-chain orientations, which are essential for overall structural stability. To address this issue, we explicitly introduce side-chain geometry into the RNA generative process. Unlike co-design frameworks that diffuse across separate raw spaces, we propose Geometric Optimized Latent Diffusion (\textbf{GOLD}), which project sequence and structure into a unified latent manifold. GOLD employs a novel GeoVAE to elegantly integrate discrete RNA sequences with continuous side-chain angles. translated_title: GOLD：面向结构感知RNA逆折叠的几何优化潜在扩散模型
translated_abstract: 设计能够折叠成特定三维结构的RNA序列是治疗学领域的一项基础性挑战。当前的RNA逆折叠方法通常以三维骨架坐标作为条件，但其生成仅限于一维离散序列，这忽略了对于整体结构稳定性至关重要的连续侧链取向。为了解决这一问题，我们在RNA生成过程中显式地引入了侧链几何信息。与那些在不同原始空间中进行扩散的协同设计框架不同，我们提出了几何优化潜在扩散模型（GOLD），将序列和结构投影到一个统一的潜在流形中。GOLD采用一种新颖的GeoVAE，将离散的RNA序列与连续的侧链角度优雅地整合在一起。通过将这些模态映射到单一、平滑的潜在流形上，GOLD自然地实现了协同扩散过程。为了增强结构有效性，我们进一步引入了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: GOLD提出几何优化的潜在扩散框架，利用GeoVAE将离散RNA序列与连续侧链角度统一映射到同一潜在流形上，实现序列与结构的协同扩散生成，从而提升RNA逆折叠的结构有效性。
en_tdlr: GOLD proposes a geometric optimized latent diffusion framework that unifies discrete RNA sequences and continuous side-chain angles on a single smooth latent manifold via a novel GeoVAE, enabling synergistic co-diffusion for structure-aware RNA inverse folding with improved structural validity.
